meta.project: Advent Engineers — Transformer Testing & Management System

product_overview: A multi-role web application to create and manage transformer orders and to run sequential CT and PT testing workflows through generation, heating, final approval and shipment. The system enables role-based worklists for entry operators, testers and admins and provides printable A4 test and heating reports.
core_goals: Allow entry operators to create transformer orders (CT or PT) with required technical details and images.
Enable admins to approve orders, generate transformer units, assign testers and manage employees.
Provide testers with role-specific assigned worklists to record sequential CT stages (core → secondary → primary → heating → final) and PT testing and to save/approve test data.
Capture heating/drying records for CT and PT jobs and transition units to final testing after approval.
Support final test submission that evaluates pass/fail and routes failures to admin review or retest as required.
Make completed tests and heating records viewable and printable in A4 layout for reporting and dispatch.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users by employee ID and password and route them to role-appropriate layouts.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select role demo credentials / fetch from API -> Fill employee ID -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> See role-appropriate dashboard
Navigate to / -> Fill employee ID -> Fill password -> Submit login form with wrong password -> See validation error for invalid credentials

features.name: Create Order (Entry Operator)
features.description: Create CT or PT orders with detailed transformer specifications, optional images, and assign initial metadata; orders remain pending approval until admin approves.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as entry-operator -> Open Create Order form -> Fill order fields (client, transformer type, quantity, cores, deadlines, specs) -> Attach images -> Submit order -> See order created with status Pending Approval
Navigate to / -> Login as entry-operator -> Open Create Order form -> Submit with required fields missing -> See validation errors and prevent submission

features.name: Admin: Approve Order and Generate Transformers
features.description: Admins review pending orders, approve them to generate transformer units and trigger initial assignments and notifications.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> See Admin dashboard -> Open pending order -> Review order details -> Approve order -> See transformers generated and order.currentStage set appropriately
Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> Open pending order that isAlreadyApproved -> Attempt to approve order -> See validation error indicating order already approved

features.name: Assign Testers and Reassign
features.description: Assign tester names and unit ranges per stage during order setup or later reassign testers for in-progress orders.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as admin or entry-operator -> Open order assignments -> Create assignments for stages with unit ranges -> Save assignments -> See assignments reflected on the order
Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> Open an in-progress order -> Change tester for a stage -> Save reassignment -> See assignment updated for all affected transformer units

features.name: CT Core Testing (Core Tester)
features.description: Core testers view assigned core-stage units, submit metering/protection/PS readings, and auto-log failed cores on result=F.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as core-tester -> View Assigned Orders (Active tab) -> Open an assigned order -> Start Testing by opening a transformer's core test form -> Fill metering readings with result P -> Submit metering test -> See reading saved as PASS and order status reflect Core Testing In Progress

Navigate to / -> Login as core-tester -> Open an assigned transformer's core test form -> Fill metering reading with result F -> Submit metering test -> See failed core auto-logged and reading locked from further edits

features.name: CT Secondary Testing
features.description: Secondary testers select cores to test, submit secondary metering/protection/PS reports and approve stage to move units to primary.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as secondary-tester -> View Assigned Transformers -> Open transformer's secondary test form -> Select core type to test -> Fill secondary metering and protection readings -> Save report -> Approve stage -> See transformer move to primary stage
Navigate to / -> Login as secondary-tester -> Open secondary test form -> Try to approve without required readings -> See validation errors preventing approval

features.name: CT After-Primary (Primary) Testing
features.description: After-primary testers complete primary-level meter/protection/PS testing and approve units to transition to the heating stage.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as after-primary-tester -> View Assigned Orders at primary stage -> Open transformer's primary test form -> Fill after-primary metering and protection data -> Save report -> Approve stage -> See transformer transition to heating stage

features.name: CT Heating Record (CT)
features.description: Record heating/drying process steps for CT transformers, save drafts, and approve heating to move units to final testing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as after-primary-tester or final-tester -> Open Heating module -> Select order ready for heating -> Fill process steps, durations, left inputs and signatures -> Save (draft) -> See heating record saved with status In Progress

Navigate to / -> Login as final-tester -> Open saved heating record -> Approve heating -> See heating record status Approved and order.currentStage update to final with notifications sent to final testers

features.name: PT Testing
features.description: PT testers submit PT test reports per transformer, edit saved reports, approve individual transformers and approve whole orders when all units have tests.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as pt-tester -> View Assigned Tab -> Open a PT transformer -> Open PTTestingReport -> Fill PT test data -> Submit PT test -> See pt_test saved and order status set to PT Testing In Progress
Navigate to / -> Login as pt-tester -> After saving pt_test for all transformers -> Approve Order -> See order.status change to PT Testing Completed and completionStages.pt set true
Navigate to / -> Login as pt-tester -> Try to approve PT order before all transformers have saved test data -> See validation error 'Not all transformers have testing data saved'

features.name: PT Heating Record
features.description: PT-specific heating record capture for PT jobs (11KV / 33KV variants) and saving records into transformer process history.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as pt-tester -> Open PT Heating Record Module -> Select PT job -> Fill heating process steps and signatures -> Save heating record -> See record persisted to processHistory.ptHeatingRecord[]

features.name: Final Testing and Submission
features.description: Final testers complete final test fields (polarity, HV, meggar readings, OVIT), submit final tests, and observe pass/fail routing including admin-review routing for specific failure types.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as final-tester -> View Assigned Transformers at final stage -> Open final test form -> Fill all final test fields with passing values -> Submit final test -> See transformer move to shipped and final_test.status Completed
Navigate to / -> Login as final-tester -> Open final test form -> Fill meggar values exceeding thresholds -> Submit final test -> See failure recorded and transformer remains in final stage
Navigate to / -> Login as final-tester -> Fill hvPrimaryWinding as Fail -> Submit final test -> See transformer currentStage set to admin_review with returnTargetStage primary

features.name: Reports and Print (Public + Admin)
features.description: View completed test and heating reports and print them in A4 layout without validation blocking the print.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as tester or admin -> Open Reports module -> Select completed report -> View report details -> Print report -> See A4-formatted print preview ready for window.print()
Navigate to / -> Open public Report Page -> View public report content without authentication -> Print report -> See A4 print output (signatures optional)

features.name: Failed Cores Management
features.description: Track failed cores automatically created on failed core readings, list and filter failed cores, and return/undo-return or bulk-return cores to vendors.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as admin or tester -> Open Failed Cores list -> Filter by failureStage or vendor -> See paginated failed core results
Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> Select multiple failed cores -> Initiate Bulk Return -> Confirm bulk return -> See selected failed cores updated with returnStatus Returned

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Receive and manage assignment and stage-transition notifications, view unread counts and mark notifications read.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as tester -> Open Notifications -> See list of recent notifications and unread count badge -> Mark one notification read -> See unread count decrement
Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> Approve order with assignments -> Observe assignment notifications created for starting stage testers

features.name: Employee Management (Admin)
features.description: Admins add employees which auto-generate employee IDs and manage employee lists (no passwords returned in lists).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> Open Add Employee form -> Fill required employee fields including password -> Submit -> See new employee with autogenerated EMP-prefixed ID
Navigate to / -> Login as admin -> Open Employees list -> Search for employee by name -> See employee details without password exposed
